namespace = kCAFG_monthly_global_events

# Setup event
kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0001 = {
	scope = none
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = kCAFG_monthly_global_events_running }
            }
        
            #debug_log = "Kei CAFG - [GetCurrentDate.GetStringLong] - Monthly Global Events Setup Event !"
            set_global_variable = kCAFG_monthly_global_events_running
            trigger_event = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002
        }
    }
}

# Update drift event
kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 = {
	scope = none
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        trigger_event = { on_action = kCAFG_monthly_global_pulse }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 1 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 31 }
            trigger_event = { on_action = kCAFG_quarterly_global_pulse }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 2 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 28 }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 3 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 31 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0003 days = 15 } # Offseted Semestrial
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 4 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 30 }
            trigger_event = { on_action = kCAFG_quarterly_global_pulse }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 5 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 31 }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 6 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 30 }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 7 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 31 }
            trigger_event = { on_action = kCAFG_quarterly_global_pulse }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 8 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 31 }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 9 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 30 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0003 days = 15 } # Offseted Semestrial
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 10 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 31 }
            trigger_event = { on_action = kCAFG_quarterly_global_pulse }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 11 }
            trigger_event = { id = kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0002 days = 30 }
        }

        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 12 }
            remove_global_variable = kCAFG_monthly_global_events_running
        }
    }
}

# Offseted Semestrial
kCAFG_monthly_global_events.0003 = {
    scope = none
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        trigger_event = { on_action = kCAFG_offseted_semestrial_global_pulse }
    }
}
